name: Jaher Era
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Jaher Era presses for legal recognition of woodland communities’ authority over commons, graves and springs. The reform treats inhabited and cared-for land as the basis of enforceable rights. The University register proposes a connection to Narmada Archives Rival Grove Concession Copies. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
